ota.summary: Innovo RedBox Fury 2026.09.21.52 - adds Device Profile (Garage Door Opener = momentary 2s / Relay Trigger = latching) as a preset that writes per-door defaults, and Relay 4 Function (Door 4 / Siren). In siren mode relay 4 switches a 12V siren directly from VIN: warn, siren stops, THEN motion; a second press aborts; All Doors CYCLE sounds one 5s warning. Warning time fixed at 5s. 'Door 5 Sensor' renamed to 'Door 5'.
